notes.title: Patch Notes – July 31, 2025
notes.content:
Thank you for playing our game!

Here are the details of this patch:



Challenge Stages Added!

8 new challenge stages have been added.

Challenge stages become available after clearing the main game.

New and Updated Stages

3 new stages have been added.

1 existing stage has been updated.

Faster, Clearer Combat and Feedback!

The battle UI has been significantly improved.

notes.title: Patch Notes – July 26, 2025
notes.content:
Thank you for playing our game!



Here are the patch notes:

Fixed a bug where moving the mouse continuously upward caused the view to rotate 360 degrees

Updated the description for the Surge bullet

Added support for \[2560 x 1440] and \[2560 x 1600] resolutions
